message:
Dear Tita Ana and Tito Arnold, 

As we begin this new chapter in our lives, we hope to be surrounded by people whose guidance and presence bring sincerity and support. It would truly be an honor for us to have you as our principal sponsors on this very special day. 

Our wedding will be an intimate gathering, shared only with the people closest to our hearts. You have always been at the very top of that list. That’s why we’ve reserved two seats especially for both of you.Your presence will make everything feel even more meaningful. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Berdean, 

From the moment we met, you became a valued friend to both of us. You have come to know Diane: the moments of challenge and joy she has experienced, and you have also come to know Chino through his story: who he is, where he comes from, and what matters most to him. In your quiet and genuine way, you have listened to both of our journeys without judgment, and that is something we deeply treasure. 

It would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our groomsmen, whose presence reflects a friendship that has always been genuine, steady, and true. 

Our wedding will be an intimate gathering, and among the people closest to our hearts, you are one of them. That’s why we’ve reserved one seat especially for you, and we sincerely hope you can join us. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Darryl, 

From the beginning, you witnessed how our story started and the moments that brought us together. You’ve been more than just a colleague; you became like an older brother to Diane and a very good friend to Chino.Having you stand beside us on this special day would make it truly meaningful. 

It would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our groomsmen, whose presence reflects a friendship that has always been genuine, steady, and true. 

Our wedding will be an intimate gathering, and among the people closest to our hearts, you were always at the top of the list. That’s why we’ve reserved one seat especially for you, and we sincerely hope you can join us. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Dawn, 

From the very beginning, you have been more than a friend , you have been a true best friend to Diane and a valued friend to Chino. You have seen Diane through the different seasons of her life, from childhood, through high school, and beyond. You were there during her most difficult times, through heartbreaks and painful experiences, and we cannot imagine this day without you witnessing her happy ending. 

It would mean the world to us to have you stand beside us as one of our bridesmaids. Your friendship has always been genuine and true, and having you with us on this special day will make our celebration even more meaningful. 

Our wedding will be an intimate gathering, and among the people closest to our hearts, you were always at the top of the list. That’s why we’ve reserved one seat especially for you, and we sincerely hope you can join us. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Harlene, 

Having you as my sister has been one of the greatest blessings of my life. From the memories we’ve shared growing up to the ways you’ve always supported me, our bond has been a constant source of joy. 

It means so much to us to have you by our side as my maid of honor. We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved Unises so you can share this special day together. Your presence will make the celebration truly unforgettable, and we cannot imagine celebrating this moment without you standing with us. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We cannot wait to share this special day with you and honor the bond we’ve shared as sisters all these years. 

With all our love, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Hayllie, 

Some people become part of our story long before we understand how important they will be. You are one of them. You were there during the bride’s teenage years, sharing life as it unfolded, offering friendship that remained through time and change. 

That bond never faded. It grew quietly and stayed true, and it is something we both value deeply. When we think of the people who have shaped our journey to this day, you are always among them. 

As we begin this new chapter together, it would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our bridesmaids. Your presence carries history, care, and a connection that cannot be replaced. 

We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved, June Lloyd, so you may share this day together with us. Having you close would make this celebration feel complete. 

Please let us know your response by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We truly hope you will be there. 

With love and gratitude 

Diane & Chino

Dear J-Ann, 

It feels like it was just yesterday when we were all together, sharing laughter and simple moments as co-workers. We never imagined that, somewhere along the way, love would quietly begin to blossom between the two of us. 

You witnessed the journey from the very start. You saw how everything unfolded, how we went from being co-workers, to becoming friends, and eventually finding ourselves as partners in life. That is something we will always be grateful for.

With this gratitude in our hearts, we warmly invite you to take a special place in our celebration. It would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our bridesmaids,someone whose presence reflects a friendship that has always been genuine, steady, and true. 

We would also love for you to come with someone close to your heart, so we’ve set aside three seats especially for you and your kids, to ensure you feel as comfortable and warmly welcomed as you have always made us feel. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Tita Jhayne, 

Throughout Diane’s life, from childhood into adulthood, you have been her safe haven: the one she could always lean on when the world felt too heavy, the one whose love and care seemed to understand her in ways no one else could. You have also welcomed Chino as part of Diane’s life, seeing him as someone important to her and supporting both of us along the way. That is why we cannot imagine celebrating this very special day of our lives without you by our side. 

Having you accept to be our Ninang would not only be a blessing, but also guidance we truly value as we begin building our life together. 

Our wedding will be an intimate gathering, and among the people closest to our hearts, you are one of them. That’s why we’ve reserved one seat especially for you, and we sincerely hope you can join us. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Lyne, 

Being your sister has always been one of the greatest gifts in our lives. Growing up together, sharing laughter, mischief, mistakes, victories, and challenges that only we truly understand, has shaped our bond and made it unbreakable. 

It means so much to us to have you stand with us as a bridesmaid on our wedding day. We reserved two seats for you and your beloved Shean so you can share this special day together. Having you there will make the celebration feel complete, because this day is about the people who have been part of our lives from the heart of it all. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We cannot wait to celebrate this day with you, and to honor the bond we’ve shared as sisters all these years. 

With all our love, 

Diane & Chino

Tito Noel at Tita JoCelyn, 

Mula pa nang isilang si Diane, naging bahagi ka na ng kanyang buhay bilang Ninong sa kanyang binyag. Isa ka sa mga tao na nagpakita ng malasakit, pagmamahal, at gabay sa bawat yugto ng kanyang buhay. Tinanggap mo rin si Chino bilang bahagi ng kanyang mundo, kung kaya't isang kagalakan para sa amin ang tanggapin mo ang aming paanyaya na maging isa sa aming mga ninong sa kasal. Ang pagtanggap mo dito ay hindi lamang isang pagpapala, kundi gabay sa aming pagsasama. 

Nais din naming makasama ang iyong minamahal na si Tita Jo, na naging mahalagang parte rin ng aming kabanata. Ipinakita niya ang kanyang kabutihan, pagmamahal, at suporta sa aming dalawa na tunay naming pinahahalagahan. Kung kaya naman, hindi namin maisip na wala kayo sa espesyal na araw na ito. 

Ang aming kasal ay isang maliit at simpleng pagtitipon lamang at sa aming pagpili ng mga taong iimbitahan, walang pag-aalinlangan na kayo ay kabilang dito. Kaya naman, nagreserba kami ng dalawang upuan para sa inyo. Ang presensya ninyong dalawa sa aming espesyal na araw ay napakahalaga sa amin, at labis naming ikalulugod na makasama kayo sa aming selebrasyon. 

Upang makumpirma po ang inyong pagdalo, inaanyayahan po namin kayong magpadala ng tugon sa pamamagitan ng Facebook Messenger: Diane Rivera Manalang o Chino Lam Jr 

Lubos po ang aming pasasalamat, 

Diane & Chino

Papa, 

Sa pagsisimula ng bagong yugto ng aming buhay, ninanais po naming mapalibutan kami ng mga taong naging gabay, suporta, at sandigan namin, mga taong itinuring na rin namin na parang tunay na magulang. At wala pong pag-aalinlangan, isa kayo sa kanila. 

Kaya naman, malaking karangalan po para sa amin kung tatanggapin ninyo ang aming taos-pusong hiling na maging isa sa aming mga ninong sa kasal. Ang inyong pagtanggap ay hindi lamang isang pagpapala, kundi magiging isang mahalagang gabay sa panibagong yugto ng aming buhay. 

Nais din po namin na makasama ninyo ang mahal ninyong si Mama at si Missy, na kapwa naging malapit at mahalaga na rin po sa amin. Kaya naman, naglaan po kami ng tatlong upuan para lamang sa inyo upang inyong masaksihan ang araw na napakaespesyal para sa amin. 

Upang makumpirma po ang inyong pagdalo, inaanyayahan po namin kayong magpadala ng tugon sa pamamagitan ng Facebook Messenger: Diane Rivera Manalang o Chino Lam Jr. 

Lubos po ang aming pasasalamat at pagmamahal, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Shean, 

You were there when Chino courted Diane, and of course, you knew exactly what that felt like—after all, as you were also courting Diane’s sister at the same time! 🤣 How funny it all was. You witnessed how this story began, it was clear how much heart and warmth you bring to the family. Your presence, your laughter, and the way you get along with everyone have always stood out, and it’s something we truly value. 

Having you stand with us as a groomsman on our wedding day means so much, because this day is about the people who make our lives brighter. 

We’ve reserved two seats for you and Lyne so you can enjoy the day together and be part of this special celebration with us. Your presence will make everything feel even more meaningful. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We’re really looking forward to celebrating this day with you. 

With love, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Unises, 

You’ve become such an important part of our lives, and it means so much to us to have you stand with us as a groomsman on our wedding day. From the moments we’ve shared and the joy you bring to our family, your presence has always mattered to both of us. 

We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved Harleen so you can enjoy this special day together. Having you there will make the celebration feel complete,surrounded by the people who mean the most to our hearts. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We truly look forward to celebrating this day with you. 

With love,

Diane & Chino

Dear Mommy Ysabelle, 

From the very beginning, you have been more than just a colleague to us; you became our Mommy, someone who guided and looked after us with sincerity, and remained close even beyond the walls of work. You witnessed where our story first began, saw how our ordinary days as co-workers slowly grew into something deeper, and played a quiet but meaningful role in the journey that led us here. We truly believe that God placed you in our lives with purpose, especially in the story that brought us together. 

As we enter this new chapter of our lives, we can’t help but think of the people who have inspired us and shown us what genuine love looks like. Having you as our Ninang is not only a blessing, but also a guidance we truly value as we begin building our life together as husband and wife. With that, it would be an honor for us to have you as one of our principal sponsors. 

We would also love for you to come with someone close to your heart, so we’ve set aside two seats especially for you — to ensure you feel as comfortable and warmly welcomed as you have always made us feel. 

We kindly request you to confirm your attendance by sending us a message on Facebook Messenger : Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Chino & Diane

Dearest Mama Aimee, 

Growing up, you were the heart of my home and the person who shaped me into the man I am today. Your love wasn't just a word; it was the steady, daily presence of someone who chose to lead me, guide me, and stay by my side through everything. From my earliest childhood years to now, you have been my constant anchor, making sure I always felt seen, held, and truly cared for. 

​It would mean the world to Diane and me to have you right there as I take this next big step. We’ve kept a very special place for you so you can witness the life you helped me build from the ground up. My wedding day simply wouldn't feel the same without you; I can't imagine standing at that altar and marking this milestone if you aren't there to give me your blessing. 

​Please let us know if you can join us by messaging Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. on Facebook Messenger. I can’t wait to see you, to give you a huge hug, and to honor the lifelong bond we share. 

With all our love, 

Chino & Diane

Dearest Mama Babie, 

Having you as my mother is a gift that has shaped the man I am today; you’ve shown me that the heart has a way of building a home, and that a mother’s love is defined by the steady, daily presence of someone who chooses to lead the way. From my childhood years, you were the one who was physically always there—my constant anchor and my guide. Your love has been so unwavering that I have always felt seen, held, and truly cared for. 

It means the world to us to have you with us as I take this next big step. We have reserved a special place for you so you can share this day with us and witness the life you helped me build. Your presence would make the celebration truly unforgettable; I cannot imagine standing at the altar and marking this milestone without you there. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We cannot wait to share this day with you, to hug you, and to honor the lifelong bond we have shared. 

With all our love, 

Chino & Diane

Dearest Gelo, 

Growing up, we each found our own way, but I always knew I had a brother who had my back. Having you as my younger brother has been one of the greatest blessings of my life, and even as our lives moved on different timelines, the bond we’ve built has remained a constant I truly treasure. 

You’ve seen me at my lowest points and through every setback. During the times I felt stuck, your encouragement was what reminded me that I could always bounce back. Now that I’m stepping into this new chapter—having found my forever partner and a love that feels like a true victory—it means the world to me to have you standing there as my groomsman. 

We’ve made sure to reserve seats for you and your daughters, Nixie and Bea, so you can all be part of this memory together. This milestone wouldn’t feel complete without you there to witness it; I can’t imagine marking this moment at the altar without my brother by my side. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We’re so excited to share this day with you and celebrate the brotherhood we’ve shared all these years. 

With all our love, 

Chino & Diane

Dearest Dave, 

Having you in my life has been one of the greatest blessings. You have been a true 'constant' for me—the realest friend I could ask for—especially as we’ve journeyed deeper in our walk with Lord Jesus. From the energy of our basketball games to the spiritual strength of our worship nights, inter-church fellowships, and the annual Octoberpraise concerts, our bond has been a source of immense joy. 

It means so much to us to have you by our side as my groomsman. We have reserved a seat for you so you can share this special day with us. Your presence will make the celebration truly unforgettable, and we cannot imagine celebrating this moment without you standing with us. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We cannot wait to share this special day with you and honor the bond we’ve shared as brothers all these years. 

With all our love, 

Chino & Diane

Dear Airen, 

We are so happy to have you as part of our wedding day as a bridesmaid. Your presence will make this special day even more meaningful, and we’re grateful that you’re joining us to celebrate this important moment. 

It means a lot to have friends and family around us who support and share in our joy, and we’re looking forward to creating wonderful memories together on the wedding day. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We can’t wait to celebrate this beautiful day with you! 

With love, 

Diane & Chino

Dearest Allan, 

Before we were men standing at an altar, we were just two kids in a computer cafes, brothers-in-arms plotting our next bit of mischief. Having you by my side for all these years has been one of the greatest blessings of my life. From our high school days of late-night DOTA 'GGWPs' to the real-world battles we've faced since, our bond has been the one constant through it all. 

Beyond the games, you have been my constant inspiration to always be more—to aspire more, to dream more, and to never settle. You’ve been there to witness my setbacks and the times I was stuck in 'low priority' in life, always helping me buy back into the game when things got tough. Now that I’ve finally navigated the map and secured my 'endgame'—winning in love and finding my forever teammate—it means everything to me to have you by my side as my best man. 

We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved Chely so you can share this special day together. Your presence will make the celebration truly unforgettable; I cannot imagine standing at the altar and locking in this final victory without you there. 

Please let us know if you can join by sending a message on Facebook Messenger through Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We cannot wait to share this special day with you and honor the brotherhood we’ve shared all these years. 

With all our love, 

Chino & Diane

Hi Jaundy, 

You’ve always been such an important part of our lives, and we feel so blessed to have you as part of our wedding day. It means a lot to us that you’ll be standing with us as a little bridesmaid, sharing in this special celebration. 

We’ve reserved six seats for you, including your siblings Justin and James, your parents Tito Jimmy and Tita Maricel, and of course your kuya Justin’s partner, Airen, who has been a part of our family as well, so you can all enjoy the day together. Having family and genuine people like you around makes this day even more meaningful, and we’re excited to create wonderful memories together that we’ll cherish forever. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We can’t wait to celebrate this beautiful day with you! 

With love, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Mama, 

Lubos po kaming nagpapasalamat na nakilala namin ang isang taong puspos ng pagmamahal at kabutihan tulad ninyo. Ang inyong gabay, pagmamahal, at suporta ay napakahalaga sa amin, at labis po kaming nagpapasalamat sa lahat ng naibahagi ninyo sa amin. 

Sa aming espesyal na araw,  ang inyong presensya ang siyang pinakamahalagang regalo para sa amin. Nakalaan po ang tatlong upuan para sa inyong tatlo nila Papa, at  Mhissy. Ang araw na ito ay hindi lamang patungkol sa aming dalawa kundi  patungkol na din sa pagmamahal, pamilya, at sa mga taong may malaking bahagi sa aming buhay—at isa po kayo sa mga iyon. 

Sana po ma-enjoy ninyo ang bawat sandali at maging bahagi ng mga alaala na ating bubuuin sa espesyal na araw na ito. 

Maraming pagmamahal at taos-pusong pasasalamat po, 

Diane & Chino

Hi Mhissy, 

You’ve been such a nice and genuine person, and we feel so blessed to have you as part of our wedding day. It means a lot to us that you’ll be standing with us as a bridesmaid, sharing in this special celebration. 

We’ve reserved three seats for you and your parents, Mama and Papa, so you can all enjoy the day together. Having people like you around makes this day even more meaningful, and we’re excited to create wonderful memories together that we’ll cherish forever. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We can’t wait to celebrate this beautiful day with you! 

With love, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Mommy and Daddy, 

It’s hard to put into words just how much you mean to us. You’ve been there since the very beginning, guiding and supporting us every step of the way.  

From Diane's very first steps, to her first dreams, to the woman she is today, you’ve always been by her side. 

Seeing her grow into the amazing person she has become makes us so grateful for you. 

Now, as we prepare for this next chapter—the day she gets married—it fills us with joy to know that you will be the one to walk Diane down the aisle. There’s no one else we could imagine in that special role, and having you by her side at that moment is truly priceless. 

We’ve saved 2 special seats for both of you so you can fully enjoy the day, knowing how much you’ve shaped it and how much you are loved. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Chino Lam Jr. We can’t wait to share this beautiful day with you—and to honor the incredible parentS that you are. 

With all our love and gratitude, 

Chino & Diane

Dear Justin, 

You’ve been such an important part of Diane’s life from the very beginning. Growing up together, sharing childhood memories, and witnessing all the ups and downs she’s been through, you know her story better than most. 

The support and  bond you share with her have always stood out. Now, having you stand with us as a groomsman on our wedding day means so much. This day is about the people who have shaped our lives—and you’ve certainly played a big part in Diane’s journey.We’ve reserved six seats for you and your family: your siblings Jaundy and James, your parents Tito Jimmy and Tita Maricel, and of course, the love of your life, Airen. We hope you can all enjoy the day together and be part of this special celebration with us. Your presence will make everything feel even more meaningful. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We’re really looking forward to celebrating this day with you and your loved ones! 

With love and gratitude, 

Diane & Chino

Dear Franchescka, 

We are so happy to have you as part of our wedding day as one of our bridesmaids. Your presence will make this special day even more meaningful, and it truly means a lot to us to have you there. 

You’ve already become such a lovely part of the family, and it makes our celebration even more special knowing that the people closest to us—including you—will be there to share this moment. We’re so grateful to celebrate this important milestone surrounded by love, support, and the people who mean so much to us. 

Please let us know if you can join us by sending a message on Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We can’t wait to celebrate this beautiful day together and create wonderful memories. 

With love, 

Diane & Chino
